rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose term for a woman whose main role is looking after the home.

example.english: The housewife does not have to go to work and looks after the children and cooks every day.
example.traditional: 住家婆唔使返工，日日湊仔煮飯。
example.jyutping: zyu6 gaa1 po4 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 jat6 jat6 cau3 zai2 zyu2 faan6

rows.note: Use this more formal term when explicitly referring to homemaking as a woman’s occupation.

example.english: She chose to become a housewife and devote herself to looking after the family.
example.traditional: 佢選擇成為家庭主婦，專心照顧家庭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 syun2 zaak6 sing4 wai4 gaa1 ting4 zyu2 fu5 zyun1 sam1 ziu3 gu3 gaa1 ting4

rows.note: This shorter written term is used when the context already makes the household role clear.

example.english: The housewife is mainly responsible for managing the household and caring for the family.
example.traditional: 主婦主要負責料理家務，照顧家庭。
example.jyutping: zyu2 fu5 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 liu6 lei5 gaa1 mou6 ziu3 gu3 gaa1 ting4
